content.raw:
Balanced nutrition plays an important part in both preventing illness and supporting medical treatment. The nutrition and dietetics team at our partner hospital assesses your eating habits and body composition and develops a personalised nutrition plan with regular follow-up. MedLuxLife coordinates your consultations and can combine them with other treatments during your stay.

Treatments and services

Initial assessment and body analysis

Review of eating habits plus body analysis to measure fat, muscle and water percentages and regional fat distribution.

Personalised nutrition therapy

A plan based on age, height, sex, physical activity and blood test results, with regular follow-up appointments.

Inpatient nutrition

Menus for hospitalised patients are planned together with doctors, the patient and relatives, and monitored from preparation to delivery.

Home nutrition education

Guidance during the hospital stay on how to continue the nutrition plan at home.

Support around obesity surgery

Nutritional preparation before bariatric surgery to help reduce surgical risk, and guidance on sustainable lifestyle changes afterwards.

Home-based monitoring

On request, follow-up at home for elderly or bedridden patients.

Corporate services

Nutrition and diet counselling and customised menu planning for private organisations.

Education and awareness

Seminars, training sessions and media work to raise awareness of healthy eating.

Areas of medical nutrition

  • Medical nutrition in obesity
  • Medical nutrition in diabetes mellitus
  • Medical nutrition in liver diseases
  • Medical nutrition in kidney diseases
  • Medical nutrition in high blood pressure and cardiovascular diseases
  • Medical nutrition for rheumatism and gout
  • Medical nutrition for oncology patients
  • Malnutrition (extreme thinness and inadequate nutrition)
  • Nutrition with food allergies and food intolerances
  • Healthy nutrition in infancy, childhood and adolescence
  • Healthy nutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding
  • Sports nutrition

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Recent blood test results
  • A short food diary of a typical week

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Nutrition and Dietetics consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
